articles.title: Amazon debuts the Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time smart clock, plus other upgraded devices - TechCrunch
articles.description: Amazon's other new devices include an upgraded Echo Dot, an Echo Studio with visual intelligence features, and the Echo Show 16.
articles.content:
Amazon unveiled five new Alexa devices today, including two new kinds of hardware: the Alexa Photo Frame, a smart picture frame, and the Echo Time, a smart alarm clock.
